args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.2.9 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Note: v2.3.0, the most recent previously-healthy production release, is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417 and could not be used, so the rollback target was v2.2.9.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened a SEV2 incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy (error rate 0.18) on v2.3.1 in all regions.
2. Attempted to roll back to v2.3.0 (the most recent healthy production release), but it was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to **v2.2.9** (the next most recent healthy production release) across all regions — us-east, us-west, and eu-west now report `rolled_out`.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** for checkout-api, describing the health-check failures and the rollback (including the note that v2.3.0 was skipped due to the CVE quarantine).
